summary:
[  edit  ]
The Evaluate  DAT  changes the cells of the incoming  DAT  using string-editing and math expressions.
In its simplest form, without an input  DAT  attached, you can put any python expression in the  Expression  parameter of an Evaluate  DAT . To evaluate the expression every frame you may need to put the parameter into  Expression   Parameter Mode .
With a  DAT  attached, it outputs a table with the same number of rows and columns as the input.
The  Scope  page can be used to restrict which rows and columns of cells are affected.
When the  Output  menu is set to Expressions, it causes the input cells to be evaluated as Pythong expressions.  me.inputCell.val  is the value of the input cell.
The optional second input  DAT  is an array of expressions which are matched to the cells of the input, then evaluated and output. If there are fewer rows in the second  DAT  than the first, the expressions in the last row of the second input are repeated. If there are fewer columns in the second  DAT  than the first, the last column is repeated.
Expressions are optimized by storing a compiled internal version, which runs much faster.   Use this where possible.  If you are reusing expressions by repeating them in a table, having an input table with the few expressions you will cycle through separate from the data will also improve performance.
If the second  DAT  is one cell, like the  Expression  parameter, it applies its expression to all the input cells. A one-cell second  DAT  with  me.inputCell.val+1  adds 1 to all the first input's cells.

The Evaluate  DAT  maintains the format of the first input  DAT  (table or text) unless the Output Table Size parameter is used.

parameters.label: Input  Expression
parameters.name: expression
parameters.description: Passes through first input if there is no second input. Otherwise passes through second input. If the first input has more rows or columns than the second one, then the last row or column of the second is repeated to fill out the extra cells.

parameters.label: Expression
parameters.name: expr
parameters.description: Expression  used to evaluate each cell if an  Expression  input or  DAT  is not supplied.

parameters.label: Output Table Size
parameters.name: outputsize
parameters.description: ⊞  - If the Output Table Size parameter is Strings, Expressions, or Commands, and there is a second input, you can choose the output table size to be either Input  DAT  or the Formula  DAT .  If the Formula  DAT  is chosen and its table size is greater than the input data table, then the last cell in each row or column will be used when evaluating the remaining formulas.

parameters.label: Monitor Data Dependencies
parameters.name: dependency
parameters.description: If the Output parameter is set to Strings or Expressions, the  DAT  will monitor any nodes used by the data, as well as check for time dependencies, and cook accordingly. This toggle is on by default. If you only want the  DAT  to cook based on input changes, you can turn this off to avoid unnecessary updates.
